extension_points: Operation registrations supply typed handlers and feature-specific candidate validation.

state_failure_version_rules: This is an L1 draft design contract: no compiled public consumer, BP execution, L2 integration or capability completion is asserted by this file.
All document mutation uses the shared coordinator, document/epoch/revision checks and atomic persistent history; GUI/script/AI cannot bypass it.
Unimplemented advanced capabilities report unavailable; data/reference errors never become a partially committed model.
Same-key/same-params retry returns original fact; same-key/different-params conflicts.
Atomic DB/RAM publication prevents half/duplicate commits, including undo then replay of old successful request.
BP-12 100 undo/redo cycles after one move have exact revision delta 201 and exact golden states.
Persisted operation/delta/schema versions and history quotas govern recovery; unsupported versions reject.
